title: Velyx component
description: Manifest of one component in the Velyx registry (registry/components/<name>/component.json).

name.description: Component name, used in `velyx add <name>`. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

description.description: One sentence shown in `velyx list` and the docs.

requires.description: Minimum versions the user's project must meet. Defaults: PHP 8.2, Laravel 11, Livewire 3.

components.description: Other Velyx components installed alongside this one.

composer.description: Composer packages, optionally pinned as vendor/package@version.

npm.description: npm packages, optionally pinned as package@version.

files.description: Files copied into the user's project.

path.description: Path relative to the component folder.

target.description: Destination relative to the project's components root (velyx.json components.path).
